evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Computer use agents (CUAs), which use graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to complete tasks on a computer, have recently surpassed human performance on many standard benchmarks, including difficult long-horizon tasks.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We also demonstrate that we can effectively reduce the evaluation task set of most CUA benchmarks without degrading overall statistical power, allowing for more efficient benchmarking and comparison.
